'''House Rist''' was the estate of [[House Rist]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]], that was located in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] it was infiltrated by [[Cipher Nine]], an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|intelligence agency]], in order to find and neutralize [[Denri Ayl]]. [[Victor Rist]] also was killed within the walls of the estate during that year.
